name: Tunis
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: Tunis municipality/governorate; Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre (OTC) and Office National de la Propriété Foncière administer national cadastre and title registry.
registryBasis: Official OTC mandatory-registration procedures apply to non-registered properties throughout Tunisian territory, with cadastral surveying and final parcel plans. This documents a registration mechanism applicable in Tunis; it does not prove complete city registration. The planned OTC geoportal is not a verified public parcel API.
findings: Tunisia’s OTC has a statutory national cadastre/land-registration role. The official cadastral geoportal project page describes intended interactive Web-GIS services but says uniform cadastral databases and system rollout are still in progress; it exposes no public map query, endpoint, or downloadable parcel layer. A government remote map covers state-owned property only. Search snippets and opened page content are recorded separately from any API fetch; no parcel-vector request was made.
